Sara — thanks for the clear list. High level answers up front, then I'll loop in our infra/legal owners for a short playbook and concrete artifacts.

1) SCCs vs. UK IDTA: For EU subjects we provide standard EU SCCs (controller-to-processor) and will support the UK IDTA + UK Addendum for UK-resident data. Where routing would cause data to transit to a US subprocessor, we rely on SCCs + documented technical and organizational safeguards; for UK subjects we also offer the UK Addendum on request.

2) Onshore telemetry/eval data: We can scope 'telemetry' retention controls per-account on Dedicated and Private deployments. For Hosted API it's more constrained but we offer customer-level opt-outs for telemetry capture and an exportable logs feed for customers with a Dedicated contract.

3) TIA/DTIA evidence: We can produce a TIA scoping memo and subprocessor evidence package (attestation, location map, subprocessors list). For subprocessors in India we have quantized risk notes and network egress diagrams; DTIA-level testing (where required) will be handled with a scoped SOW.

I'll attach a first-draft playbook + an initial TIA question spreadsheet for your team to review. Can we schedule 30 min tomorrow to walk through gaps?

Best,
Grace O'Connor

Grace / Marissa — quick technical summary below that I suggest we put into the playbook (bullet form). I kept it short for procurement.

- Hosted API: default routing is region-aware. EU-origin requests are served from EU pools when capacity permits. Policy-based fallback can route to US-compatible model variants when EU capacity is constrained; this is documented in our SLA exceptions doc.
- Dedicated: customer-pinned pools (EU-only) are supported for Dedicated and Private. If a customer purchases Dedicated EU pools, no US-subprocessor access is required for inference.
- Subprocessor egress: some managed services (logging, evaluation pipeline) may transmit telemetry to partner locations (control plane engineering). For Medix we can opt to provide 'no-eval' telemetry configuration or route eval to an on-prem partner.
- SCC applicability: EU SCC (C2P) is applied for Hosted and Dedicated. For UK subjects, we can execute the UK IDTA + UK Addendum.

Questions for legal: any constraints on offering 'no-eval' defaults to Hosted accounts? Also need language for the DPA appendix re: fallbacks & model-variant routing.

Karthik
